get.description: Lists services owned by vendorId. categoryId, active, vehicleType, and durationMinutes are optional filters. vehicleType returns offerings with a price for that vehicle and projects vehiclePricing to that entry. Pages keep querying the vendor partition until the limit is filled.

parameters.name: vehicleType
parameters.description: Canonical vehicle type. Invalid values are rejected. The list vehiclePricing array contains only this entry.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true or false. Omit to return both.

parameters.name: durationMinutes
parameters.description: Match a configured duration. With vehicleType, matches that vehicle's duration.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Continuation token from the previous page
